title: Football finals in Scoreboard
lede: Final scores combine UWBadgers and ESPN on existing football events. Scores appear only when game identity, both numeric results, and the official W/L/T agree.

sections.heading: Desktop component states
sections.note: After-only fixture using the actual score and refresh components with application CSS. No authenticated app or database. No trustworthy authenticated before capture was available, so there is no before/after comparison.

shots.title: Desktop light fixture
shots.cap: 1100 × 820 CSS pixels, light appearance. Verified, disputed, pending, and delayed-refresh states. Wisconsin is always the first score; source links lead to public game pages.

sections.heading: Narrow layout and recovery
sections.note: A mocked partial refresh produces the status message. This capture proves component presentation and interaction only.

shots.title: Narrow dark fixture
shots.cap: 390 × 844 CSS pixels, dark appearance. Source links wrap without horizontal overflow. Their measured target height is 40 CSS pixels. Body text uses Arial as a fixture fallback for app-loaded Geist.

verification: 92 focused tests passed across 13 files: parsing, identity matching, refresh persistence, permissions, team/person Scoreboard regressions, native source contracts, and cron rules/authentication.
TypeScript and targeted ESLint passed. The compile-only application build passed and generated 272 pages; pre-existing kiosk dashboard and Sidebar unused-variable warnings remain.

Offline Prisma migration generation and validation passed. A disposable PostgreSQL 17 instance accepted the forward migration and verified uniqueness, foreign key rejection, cascading delete, and generated Prisma relation reads with serializable advisory locking. The instance was stopped afterward.
Playwright checked status presentation, non-JSON failure recovery, partial refresh status, keyboard reachability, source target height, no horizontal overflow, and no browser page errors.

Both full public provider payloads agree on all four completed football games. Minimal fixtures and public-input hashes are retained. UW calendar W/L/T and crew participation math remain authoritative.
notes: No commit, push, PR, deployment, or hosted database mutation has been performed. GAP-88 tracks rollout.

This branch has no hosted preview because it has no open PR to main. After authorized commit/push/PR and successful CI/Managed previews, apply the migration through the branch-owned environment and verify authenticated refresh, persistence, audit records, permissions, and both full Scoreboard routes.
One TypeScript attempt raced the build's regeneration of generated type files; an isolated rerun after the build passed.
This slice covers current-season final football scores. Native presentation, other sports, richer player/team statistics, live-game data, and play-by-play remain separate work.
